<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
        <jats:p><jats:bold><jats:italic>Background</jats:italic></jats:bold>The interaction between BRCA2 BRC repeats and RAD51 is one of the great important factors affecting the homologous recombination  in <jats:italic>DNA</jats:italic> damage <jats:italic>repair </jats:italic>of tumor cells. We investigated the effect of <jats:italic>BRCA2 </jats:italic>BRC repeat mutations on outcome in patients with high grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) who received platinum-based chemotherapy.<jats:bold><jats:italic>Methods</jats:italic></jats:bold>We identified the type and location of <jats:italic>BRCA2</jats:italic> BRC repeat mutations by PCR and DNA sequencing in tumor and peripheral blood leukocytes (PBL) samples of 113 patients with stage IIIC/IV high grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC), and assessed chemotherapy-free interval (CFI), progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS).<jats:bold><jats:italic>Results</jats:italic></jats:bold>24 (21.23%) cases with somatic mutation were identified in 113 HGSOC patients. Among them, 8 (7.1%) cases with nonsense mutation resulting in BRCA2 truncation significantly prolonged median CFI (37 <jats:italic>vs</jats:italic> 8 months,<jats:italic>P</jats:italic>=0.000), PFS (43 <jats:italic>vs</jats:italic> 14 months, <jats:italic>p</jats:italic>=0.000) and OS (56 <jats:italic>vs</jats:italic> 31 months, <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>=0.002); Interestingly, 16 (14.13%) cases with missense mutation also prolonged median CFI (15 <jats:italic>vs</jats:italic> 8 months, <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>=0.044), PFS (21 <jats:italic>vs</jats:italic> 14 months,<jats:italic> P</jats:italic>=0.049) and OS ( 38 <jats:italic>vs</jats:italic> 31 months, <jats:italic>P</jats:italic>=0.037). <jats:bold><jats:italic>Conclusions</jats:italic></jats:bold>Somatic mutations in <jats:italic>BRCA2 </jats:italic>BRC5-8 repeat motifs are associated with platinum-based chemotherapy sensitivity and a better outcome in patients with HGSOC.</jats:p>
title: Somatic Mutations in BRCA2 BRC Repeat Associated with Outcome in Patients with High Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer
